about_description: Application for the white stork nest census in the field.
location_permission_content:
{app} needs your location to track your route and record where the nests are.

We will first ask for regular location access, and then we will need "Allow all the time" permission to keep tracking even when the app is in the background or your screen is locked. Please allow both to make sure your transects are stored properly.
location_permission_content_ios:
{app} needs your location to track your route and record where the nests are.

Please choose "Allow While Using App" in the next step. If iOS later asks to change the access to "Always Allow", please accept it so tracking can continue even when your screen is locked.
precise_location_required:
{app} needs precise location to record the route and the nests. Approximate location is not enough.

In the app settings, under Permissions → Location, turn on "Use precise location".

position.powerPoleWires: Low-voltage power pole — on the wires
position.powerPolePlatform: Low-voltage power pole — on a purpose-built platform
position.roof: Elsewhere on the roof (not the chimney)
position.tree: Tree (name the species in the note if possible)

state.occupiedNoYoung: Occupied nest (one adult or a pair present), certainly no young
state.occupiedUnknown: Occupied nest (one adult or a pair present), young presence not determined

codes.0: Species not observed breeding, suspected passage migrant or present only during the summer period without breeding
codes.1: Species observed during the breeding season in a possible breeding habitat
codes.2: Territorial (singing) male(s) present during the breeding season
codes.3: Pair observed in a suitable breeding habitat during the breeding season
codes.4: Territorial behavior (song, courtship flight, etc.) recorded on at least two different days with more than one week interval at the same location
codes.5: Courtship display, posturing, or courtship flight
codes.7: Agitated behavior or anxious calling of adult birds
codes.8: Breeding patch on adult birds handled
codes.9: Nest building or excavation of a nest cavity
codes.11: Found used nest/eggshells (occupied laid during the breeding season)
codes.12: Recently hatched nestlings or downy young
codes.13: Parents visiting nest under circumstances indicating nest occupancy or parents observed during incubation
codes.14: Parents removing fledglings' fecal sacs from the nest or carrying food for the fledglings
codes.16: Nest with nestlings found (observed or heard)
